scope.summary: test_rename_inline_input::rename_accesskit_nodes_present_with_correct_roles fails: an AccessKit click on the stable Apply id does not apply the preview. The click never reaches the handler - the Apply row falls outside the window clip rect, so its interact_rect is empty and nothing is hittable there, while its AccessKit node still advertises UNCLIPPED bounds.

defect_detail.site: code_editor/rename.rs:977-1027 adds a ScrollArea with .max_height(360.0).auto_shrink([false, false]) BEFORE the Apply/Cancel row, and it never shrinks: egui scroll_area.rs:717-720 keeps min(available, 360) regardless of content. The test harness viewport is 900x320 (tests/test_rename_inline_input.rs:175-176).
defect_detail.why_the_window_overflows: area.rs:667 stores state.size = content_ui.min_size() unclamped every frame; only the initial default is clamped (area.rs:481). Window(constrain: true) clamps the TOP (area.rs:559) and lets the bottom overflow.
defect_detail.why_the_click_dies: area.rs:630 sets the clip rect. ui.rs:1140 registers interact_rect = clip_rect.intersect(rect), and hit_test.rs:421-422 skips a widget whose interact_rect is negative. But response.rs:836-841 sets AccessKit bounds from the UNCLIPPED rect - which is exactly why the node-present and Role::Button assertions pass while the click silently no-ops. egui_kittest node.rs:66-76 clicks the bounding-box CENTRE with a real pointer event.
defect_detail.alternative_ruled_out: The apply path itself is sound: single_file_fallback(.., is_open_buffer = true) (rename.rs:295-323) takes the in-memory branch (:565-573), and apply_rename_preview (panel.rs:5514-5518) derives self_uri via lsp_uri() (:4416-4431), which falls back to a file URI when canonicalize fails - matching the preview URI, so the buffer WOULD contain the new text if the handler ran.
defect_detail.honest_limit: The MECHANISM (clip -> empty interact_rect -> unhittable, AccessKit bounds unclipped) is certain from source. That this specific button lands outside the 320px viewport is derived from layout code, not measured at runtime. Cheapest confirmation: print the node bounding_box before the click, or re-run with a 900x700 harness.

acceptance_criteria.AC-133-1: The diff list is clamped to what the viewport can give, reserving room for the action row - the pattern slash_commands/menu.rs:121,134-141 already uses against ctx.content_rect().
acceptance_criteria.AC-133-2: Apply and Cancel are reachable at a 320px-tall viewport. This is a real product defect: an operator with a short editor area cannot reach them either.
acceptance_criteria.AC-133-4: Confirm the mechanism at runtime before claiming the fix - print the Apply node bounding_box and show it inside the clip rect - so the diagnosis is proven, not just the symptom cleared.

proof_targets.PT-133-2: The AC-133-4 bounds readout, before and after.

That confirms the diagnosed MECHANISM - unclipped AccessKit bounds outside the clip rect with nothing hittable at that point - instead of merely clearing the symptom.
